paragraphs.text: The proposer offers a two-section 15 kV arc-resistant metal-clad switchgear lineup, fully compliant with the customer's requirements as stated in the RFP. This lineup is designed to meet the specified configuration, including 18 vacuum circuit breaker positions, two revenue metering compartments, and isolation switches, ensuring alignment with the contract documents.

The switchgear provided adheres to the arc-resistant Type 2B classification, tested and verified to meet the most conservative interpretation of IEEE C37.20.7 standards. This ensures compliance with the customer's safety and performance requirements.

A comprehensive project schedule is included with the bid, detailing the timelines for drawings, factory shipment, site delivery, lead time after receipt of order (ARO), and field works. This schedule consolidates inputs from all relevant units to provide a clear and actionable timeline.
